details.detail: Centre-screen fins. Fixed: the X is gone. The +18 deg yaw keeps each fin in its own suite, with no taupe cap. Seen one suite at a time (c_screen2) the fin matches f3 well. But from the aisle (q02 x 410-490) the pair reads as two thin free-standing boards with a gap at the apex, like a pair of open cabinet doors. f3 (2D/2G) and f4 (1D/1G) show ONE solid dark-wood panel per pair.

Forward aisle corner arm. Better: it is now one flat-topped 0.172 x 0.09 x 0.66 arm, flush with the caps. From the aisle and from above (q02 right, bed.png) it reads as the smooth L-sweep with a thick rounded prow seen in f4. From inside and behind (q03 x 690-840 y 85-140, q05 x 585-645) the r=0.035 radius on a 0.09 block rounds the whole profile, so it still reads as a pill or bolster sitting over the pier. Its inboard edge overhangs the pier by about 0.13 m, and there is a step where it meets the screen-wall cap (w_screen x 425-435).

Window-suite screen wall with the 0.08 wing and the 60 deg pier (~0.22 wide). The pier and its pill mirror now read about right against f10, where the pier is about 0.3 of the screen width. The rounded wood wing, the taupe shelf and the pier-top cap are all clean, with no notch or gap.
Reading spots (~0.075, at the header corners). Verified: they sit in the header corners (seat_front, c_front) as in f9 and f5, and the pier lamp is sized correctly. No intersections.

Headrest flap and niche. Verified: the flap measures 86/87/83 against a back of 72/66/60, which is 1.2x and neutral, as in f9 (1.17x). The niche jambs and header in fConsole now read lighter than the back. The flap's border still gives a slight framed-panel look.
Seat pillow. Verified: it is now a soft rectangle with small corner radii and no octagonal facets (seat_front, c_front), and its lavender matches f9.

Bed pillows. Verified: the lavender pillow lies low in front of the propped white pillow (q04, bed.png), as in f46. The pad and duvet are fine. The sun stripes that wash out the bed are a lighting issue.

Aisle door leaves at 15 ribs and 0.026 pitch. This is deliberate, and the moire is much reduced: w_aisle shows only slight uneven spacing and bed.png is clean. The rib count is coarser than the ~23 in pb_20, which is the accepted trade-off.
Console, tray, ottoman, walls, caps and centre divider. Unchanged and consistent with f3, f7, f10 and f47.
Seat plaque. The flush slot is right. The white text is known (pending the integrator).

issues.problem: Centre pair: two thin boards with a gap at the apex read as open cabinet doors, not the single wood panel
issues.detail: Each centre suite adds its own 0.02 fin at -hx+0.02, yawed +18 deg. The two forward ends are about 0.04+ apart, the aft ends about 0.21 apart, and nothing joins them at the top.
issues.evidence: q02_suiteAisle.png x 410-490 y 130-310 (zoomed: two boards and a gap, like a bi-fold door). omaat_f3 and f4 show one solid dark-wood panel between the D and G screens.
issues.fix: Build the fin only in the unmirrored centre unit, as one panel 0.03 thick at x = -hx (straddling the divider), yaw about 15 deg, running from the console (0.62) to H. Or keep the V but close it: add a 0.04-wide fWood end strip joining the two forward ends and a thin fWood top bridging the apex, so it reads as one wedge.

issues.problem: From inside and behind, the forward corner arm still reads as a rounded bolster
issues.detail: gRBox(0.172, 0.09, 0.66, r 0.035) is rounded on every edge, so the inboard edge above the pier shows a full round tube profile. It overhangs the pier by about 0.13 m, and there is a small step against the screen-wall cap.
issues.evidence: q03_suite1A.png x 690-840 y 85-140. q05_suiteBehind.png x 585-645 y 125-160. w_screen.png x 425-525. In omaat_f10 the inboard corner top is a flat, square-edged taupe sweep; the thick rounded prow in f4 shows only on the aisle and forward side.
issues.fix: Split the arm: a square-edged top slab (radius 0.008) 0.16 wide at H+0.0325 on the inboard side, plus the rounded 0.09 prow only on the outboard 0.08 (x > hx-0.08) and its forward end. Or move the arm's centre outboard to hx-0.06 with width 0.13, so the inboard edge sits over the wardrobe wall rather than the pier.

issues.problem: Door ribs are coarser than the real ones (15 against ~23 per leaf)
issues.detail: This is a deliberate anti-moire choice. There is slight residual uneven spacing at the studio distance.
issues.evidence: w_aisle.png right leaf, compared with pb_20.jpg.
issues.fix: Optional: a mipmapped flute texture on a quad for the cabin build. Otherwise accept.
